name: LILYGO T-Beam V1.2 (ESP32, LoRa, GPS)
description: All-in-one Meshtastic/tracker board: ESP32 (4 MB flash, 8 MB PSRAM), SX1262/SX1276 LoRa, u-blox GPS, AXP2101 power management and an 18650 holder, with USB-C, for about $31.
notes: Region-specific LoRa module: SX1262 or SX1276/SX1278 at 433/868/915/923 MHz; GNSS is a u-blox NEO-6M/M8N-class module with an RTC crystal and ceramic antenna. Always connect the LoRa antenna before transmitting.
Revisions differ: V1.1 uses an AXP192 PMU, V1.2 an AXP2101 (firmware must match). CH9102 USB-UART needs the CH343 driver on some OSes. 18650 cell is not included.
Most GPIOs are consumed by LoRa, GNSS, OLED, PMU and the button (see LILYGO pin map); only about a dozen are free on the header, so the GPIO count and board size are approximate.
A newer T-Beam Supreme (ESP32-S3, SX1262, L76K GNSS, BME280/IMU) exists if you want the S3.
